metadata.title: World Digest — November 20, 2026
metadata.summary: Nvidia's SEC probe deepened the AI rout, erasing $2.5 trillion in value and dragging the Nasdaq into correction as markets buckled.

sections.title: Major Events
sections.content:
Trump Hosts Xi and Putin, Defends Ties Amid Ukraine Strikes

Trump met Xi and Putin, calling Putin a friend, while Russia launched major attacks on Ukraine. CBS News PBS DW.com

White House Replaces Cyber Director After Outages

Kirsten Davies was tapped as national cyber director following criticism of Sean Cairncross amid tech outages. PBS

SEC Probes Nvidia's Accounting as Stock Rout Deepens

Nvidia faces an SEC investigation into accounting practices, extending a $2.5 trillion selloff. Yahoo Finance

Congress Nears Ban on Chinese Cars

Lawmakers are finalizing legislation to prohibit Chinese automakers from selling cars in the U.S., with exceptions under debate. Investor's Business Daily

US Loses Measles Elimination Status

Measles cases hit a 35-year high, and the U.S. officially lost its elimination status, prompting a federal response. The Washington Post

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Global Politics

Congress moved to avert a shutdown as GOP Sen. Ron Johnson rejected tying funding to ending the Iran war NPR. Separately, House Majority Leader Scalise backed a Senate-passed energy permitting bill Politico.

U.S. Politics & Security

The White House named Kirsten Davies as cyber chief amid widespread tech outages PBS. Sen. Thom Tillis blocked Trump's CISA nominee for denying the Jan. 6 attack The Hill and the GAO chief pick Roll Call. Lawmakers pressed Pete Hegseth on blocked military promotions The Daily Beast.

International Affairs

Trump touted Asia deals with Xi and Putin CBS News. Denmark expelled a Russian diplomat over an alleged assassination plot The Guardian. The UK and EU agreed to a Brexit reset The New York Times.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Markets Plunge Into Correction as AI Rout Deepens

The Nasdaq erased its 2026 gains, with the S&P 500 and Dow entering correction territory amid intensifying AI worries NBC News. Nvidia stock plunged 14%, losing its #2 valuation spot and facing an SEC accounting probe following CEO Jensen Huang's resignation Barron's Yahoo Finance. Bitcoin fell below $59,000, failing its "digital gold" test CNBC. Gold hit a one-year low Newsweek, while the VIX touched a seven-month high Investor's Business Daily. Taiwan's TAIEX suffered its worst week since 1990 Benzinga. The odds of a Fed rate hike are now 100% Barron's.

sections.title: Tech News
sections.content:
Google Kills Assistant on Smart Speakers, Redesigns Homepage

Google will shut off Google Assistant on smart speakers and displays in August 2027, also retiring the Nest app The Verge. Meanwhile, the company rolled out a new search homepage with AI chat history and no search button, making Gemini more prominent Ars Technica. Google's new 3D emoji demand hefty specs: 10GB free space and 6GB RAM 9to5Google.

GTA 6 Shatters Records with $3.79B Day One Sales

Take-Two announced Grand Theft Auto VI earned $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales, breaking entertainment launch records The New York Times. The release also sparked police warnings against real-life copycats BBC and criticism over a "disgusting" Lucia twist MovieWeb.

Signal Blocks AI Screen-Reading

Signal is blocking screenshots on iPhone and Android to stop AI agents like Gemini and Siri from reading your screen, citing privacy concerns The Verge.

Windows 11 Search Finally Arrives

Microsoft's last big Windows 11 update of 2026 brings the new Search experience, plus 28 changes and fixes TechPowerUp.

sections.title: Entertainment News
sections.content: Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opened fiercely with $21M in previews en route to a projected $110M+ weekend Variety. Stevie Wonder celebrated Songs in the Key of Life's 50th anniversary with a triumphant Madison Square Garden performance The New York Times. Bowen Yang publicly apologized for using an antisemitic slur against Regina Spektor on his podcast Deadline. Meanwhile, Lana Del Rey's "Crazy for You" received an official release for GTA VI Pitchfork.

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Hockey

  • Tampa Bay Lightning 3, Edmonton Oilers 1 — The Lightning end Connor McDavid’s 23-game point streak ESPN.
  • Montreal Canadiens 2, Carolina Hurricanes 1 (OT) — Hutson scores twice late, including the OT winner, to topple the league-leading Canes ESPN.
  • Minnesota Wild 4, Calgary Flames 1 — Kaprizov and Hughes extend point streaks to 13 games ESPN.

Basketball

  • Memphis Grizzlies 126, Golden State Warriors 98 — Fifth straight win as Warriors sit key players ESPN.
  • Portland Trail Blazers 124, Milwaukee Bucks 114 — Lillard scores 33 in return to Milwaukee; Bucks lose 12th straight ESPN.

Football

  • Houston Texans 26, Indianapolis Colts 3 — Stroud throws three TDs in AFC South rout ESPN.

Baseball

  • The Yankees reunite with reliever Jonathan Loáisiga on a two-year deal ESPN. Shohei Ohtani extends his New Balance pact through his playing career ESPN.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

Anthropic, PBC (ANT) is set to list on the Nasdaq on 2026-11-19, with price not set Yahoo Finance. F & M Bank Corp. (FMBM) lists on NYSE American the same day Yahoo Finance. Cizzle Brands (CZZL) follows on Nasdaq on 2026-11-20 Yahoo Finance. Later listings include ProShares Ultra/UltraShort Anthropic (ANTU/ANTY) and Clywedog Therapeutics (CLYD) on 2026-11-23, and Quantum Space (QSPC) on NYSE on 2026-11-24 Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance.

Major Indices

Stocks plunged: the S&P 500 fell 3.70% to 6,910.39, and the Nasdaq tumbled 5.28% to 22,617.73 Yahoo Finance. The Dow dropped 1.93%, while the Russell 2000 lost 2.76% Yahoo Finance. The VIX surged 26.20% to 35.89, signaling intense fear Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

All 11 SPDR sectors declined Yahoo Finance. Consumer Discretionary led losses, down 2.79%, followed by Communication Services (-2.67%) Yahoo Finance. Energy was the standout defensive performer, slipping just 0.65% Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Amazon fell hardest among megacaps, down 3.87% Yahoo Finance. Nvidia lost 3.30%, Alphabet 3.46%, and Meta 3.27% Yahoo Finance. Apple showed relative resilience, easing 0.92% Yahoo Finance.

Rates & Commodities

The 10-year Treasury yield dropped 2.77% to 4.91 Yahoo Finance. Gold slid 3.98% to $3,539.00, a sharp one-day fall Yahoo Finance. WTI crude rose 0.49% to $83.62, while Bitcoin slipped 1.72% to $61,901.82 Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
Next 24–48 Hours

  • Anthropic’s Nasdaq debut may set tone for tech sentiment amid AI rout; watch for pricing and first-day volatility
  • SEC probe into Nvidia could deepen selloff if new accounting details emerge
  • China car ban vote timing uncertain; exceptions debate may shift final scope

Next Week

  • Fed rate-hike odds at 100%—look for official guidance ahead of December meeting
  • Measles federal response likely ramps up following elimination-status loss
  • GTA VI momentum may test entertainment-sector resilience against broader market weakness

Key Uncertainty

  • Trump-Xi-Putin diplomacy could pivot sharply if Ukraine strikes escalate further
